work.description: DCXCIX (OCR DCIC): complete Extat intra limites four-section body, collegiate chapter reconstruction and full roster/endowments/appointments, insignia, execution and full datum LF35005–35009. Whole candidate and 20 LF context read. Own marginal date LF34694–34699 and Expositio label LF34702–34703 retained; prior DCXCVIII Sanctio label LF34690–34691 and following DCC marginal date/label LF34981–34989 excluded and assigned to their actual acts. XML leaves259–262 preserve substantive R→L/R→L/R→L continuation. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
